legacy_root.title: Pre-registered tournament rubric and weighted scoring contract
legacy_root.question: What EXACT scoring dimensions, weights, evidence requirements, and tie-break order will the judge panel apply, and can the rubric be pre-registered and hashed BEFORE any architecture dossier is authored so post-hoc criteria gaming is mechanically detectable? Define each dimension against the program objective function (_USER-PROMPTS.md:10487-10498, correctness first and resource efficiency last), the disqualifying conditions, and the minimum evidence an entry must carry to be scored at all rather than scored zero.
legacy_root.answer: Five strictly positive weights summing to 1.00 (4000/2500/1800/1200/500 basis points): correctness, verified_improvement, operator_usability, performance, resource_efficiency. Score is the weighted sum of [0,1] dimension marks; a strictly better vector cannot score lower. Missing minimum evidence scores 0 (INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE). Duplicate control plane, overclaim, schema-invalid, or a broken freeze are DISQUALIFIED. The sha256 of this file is recorded in command-center/phase3/ARTIFACT-MANIFEST.json; a 0.01 weight edit must fail that match. _USER-PROMPTS.md:10487-10498 is not on this worktree; dimensions are reconstructed from catalog citations (correctness first, objective 2 verified improvement at :10490, usability above performance, resource efficiency last at :10498). A1/A2 DESIGN.json already on disk predate this freeze and are ineligible as freeze-compliant entries until re-emitted. Fixture command-center/p2-wave/probes/ARC-0002/fixtures/post-freeze-dossier.json is the ordering-proof dossier.

dimensions.definition: Does the proposed control plane do the right thing on the named capability sample: load order, precedence, and expressibility verdicts match the dossier's own claims when re-run.
dimensions.evidence_required: At least one transcribed sample with source_id, plus a named probe command that a second agent can re-run.
dimensions.zero_if: Sample transcription missing, or a claimed EXPRESSIBLE construct fails mapping.

dimensions.definition: The dossier states a measurable before/after (or both-states) check. Improvement is scored only when a probe records baseline and post values, never because an agent asserted it.
dimensions.evidence_required: Named both-states or delta probe with recorded numbers.
dimensions.zero_if: No measured baseline, or improvement claimed only in prose.

dimensions.definition: An operator can locate, load, and override a capability from the declared file set without a resident runtime or a generated layer the operator cannot inspect.
dimensions.evidence_required: File set + load order + a worked example path an operator would touch.
dimensions.zero_if: Operator path depends on an unpublished generator or a hidden live tree.
dimensions.catalog_citation: command-center/WORK-UNIT-CATALOG.json rationale: objective function ranks usability above performance

dimensions.definition: Load and judge cost stays bounded: no unbounded directory walk, no extra orchestration runtime, no N-agent fan-out as a substitute for evidence.
dimensions.evidence_required: Bound stated (file count, load order length, or probe wall-clock).
dimensions.zero_if: Architecture requires a second orchestration runtime or unbounded scan.
dimensions.catalog_citation: Same catalog rationale: usability is ranked above performance, so performance is present and strictly below usability.

dimensions.definition: Tokens, wall-clock, tool calls, and estimated spend are visible next to any quality claim. Efficiency is last, not invisible.
dimensions.evidence_required: Cost fields named even when unmeasured (UNMEASURED, not omitted).
dimensions.zero_if: Quality claimed with cost fields stripped.
dimensions.catalog_citation: command-center/WORK-UNIT-CATALOG.json: _USER-PROMPTS.md:10498 resource efficiency is last, but it is on the list

scoring_rule.formula: sum_i(weight_i * mark_i) with mark_i in [0,1]; weights from basis_points/10000
scoring_rule.insufficient_evidence: Entry missing any minimum_evidence.required_fields item is scored 0 with reason INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE and is not given dimension marks.
scoring_rule.disqualified: DISQUALIFIED entries receive numeric 0 and are excluded from head-to-head ranking of qualified entries.
scoring_rule.monotonicity: All weights > 0, so if A >= B on every dimension and A > B on at least one, score(A) > score(B).

disqualifiers.condition: Entry introduces a second orchestration runtime or a second writable capability root that can silently diverge from the declared file set (catalog cites _USER-PROMPTS.md:10483).
disqualifiers.effect: DISQUALIFIED; numeric score 0; not ranked against qualified entries.

disqualifiers.condition: A load-bearing claim has verdict CONFIRMED without a file:line or probe anchor.
disqualifiers.effect: DISQUALIFIED. Overclaim is a failure class of this unit, not a low score.

disqualifiers.condition: RUBRIC.json sha256 at judging time != sha256 recorded in ARTIFACT-MANIFEST.json.
disqualifiers.effect: Judging must stop. The freeze is broken; scores are not issued.
Scored zero (INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE), not judged on dimensions.

disqualifiers.condition: Dossier mtime is not strictly after ARTIFACT-MANIFEST registered_at. Pre-existing DESIGN.json files on this worktree are in this class.
disqualifiers.effect: Ineligible as a freeze-compliant tournament entry until re-emitted after this freeze. Not silently scored.

minimum_evidence.rule: An entry is scored on dimensions only when every required field is present and samples is a non-empty list. Otherwise it is scored zero, not given the benefit of a prose claim.

pre_registration.canonicalization: file bytes with CRLF normalized to LF
pre_registration.self_hash_cycle: sha256 is stored in ARTIFACT-MANIFEST.json, not inside this file, so the digest does not include itself.
pre_registration.frozen_when: This file's bytes are frozen at emit; ARC-0003 and later dossiers must not rewrite it. Catalog: rubric is frozen once ARC-0003 starts.
pre_registration.independent_reviewer_not_on_panel: probe1_preregistration.py checks hash/mutation/order only; it does not sit on the judge panel that applies weights.

catalog_tests_required: Pre-registration test: assert rubric sha256 in the manifest equals the sha256 on disk at judging time (a post-hoc edit must fail this)
Weight-sum and monotonicity test: weights sum to 1.0 and a strictly better entry on one dimension, equal elsewhere, cannot score lower
Negative control: mutate one weight by 0.01 and assert the pre-registration test FIRES

catalog_output_schema.reason: The declared path is a generated $ref shim to https://ast-integrate.invalid/platform/schema/artifact-class-profiles.schema.json#/$defs/tournament-score. jsonschema 4.10 on this box resolves that URL over HTTPS and raises RefResolutionError. G-1 does not consult output_schema. The physical tournament-score class is generic_report with additionalProperties false, which cannot carry the load-bearing top-level dimensions probes read. No ADV rebuild into a receipt shell.
